strings.utility.ntfs3.name: Fix NTFS mounting BUG
strings.utility.ntfs3.description: Fixes a Recalbox issue that prevents some NTFS drives from mounting correctly and being used to play movies from Kodi. The utility first checks whether the patch is already installed. If required, it updates 3mounts to use the ntfs3 driver and adds ntfs3 to the supported file-system list.
strings.utility.clean_media.name: Clean orphaned media files
strings.utility.clean_media.description: Scans the selected ROM folders and removes images, thumbnails and videos that are not referenced by the gamelist.xml file. Folders with no content or without a gamelist.xml file will be skipped.

strings.utility.mame.name: Validate MAME ROMS
strings.utility.mame.description: Analyzes the MAME system ROMS and determines which are valid, incompatible, unknown, or protected files required by other games. ROMS are never deleted: when correcting, incompatible ROMS are moved to “invalids” and unknown ROMS to “unknown”, so the user can decide whether to delete them manually. Their gamelist.xml entries, per-game configuration and unreferenced media files are also removed.

strings.utility.neogeo.name: Validate NEOGEO ROMS
strings.utility.neogeo.description: Analyzes Neo Geo ROMS and determines which are valid, incompatible, unknown, or protected files required by other games. It automatically discovers the cores and formats supported by Recalbox, prioritizing its default core. ROMS are never deleted: when correcting, incompatible ROMS are moved to “invalids” and unknown ROMS to “unknown”, so the user can decide whether to delete them manually. Their gamelist.xml entries, per-game configuration and unreferenced media files are also removed.

strings.utility.services.name: Restart services
strings.utility.services.description: Reloads the Recalbox interface or completely restarts the remote system without requiring physical access to it.
strings.utility.services.emulationstation_descri: Restarts only EmulationStation, the interface that displays Recalbox systems, games and menus. This is useful for reloading ROMS and gamelist.xml changes without restarting the whole system. It will not run while a game or Kodi is active.
strings.utility.services.recalbox_description: Completely restarts the Recalbox system. All services will stop, the current connection will close, and the system will take a few moments to become available again.
strings.utility.services.shutdown_description: Safely shuts down the Recalbox system completely. All services will stop and the current connection will close. The device must be physically powered on before it can be used again.
strings.utility.services.confirm_emulationstatio:
EmulationStation will close and start again. The Recalbox system will not be restarted.

Do you want to continue?

Do you want to continue?
